trans-unit.source: Turns this content element into a schema.org type. Leave empty to not add any structured data for this content element.
Adds the type as mainEntity of the page instead of a standalone node. Several content elements on the same page can each be a main entity, for example several Question elements on an FAQPage.

Property name/value pairs for the selected type, as a flat JSON object with plain strings/numbers/booleans only, for example {"name": "Some product", "sku": "ABC-123"}. Not suited for properties whose value must be another type (for example offers, acceptedAnswer, aggregateRating, or a carousel's items) - implement a StructuredDataProviderInterface for those.
